title: Telugu Conversational Foundations
description: Master essential Telugu greetings, introductions, family terms, and daily interactions with support for automatic translation into Hindi, Tamil, or other languages.

lessons.title: Greetings

content.example: शुभ दोपहर, आप आपकी कैसे मदद कर सकते हैं?
शुभ संध्या, कार्यक्रम में आपका स्वागत है!
आपकी मदद के लिए आपको धन्यवाद।
क्षमा करें, मैं रुकावट नहीं डालना चाहता था।
अलविदा, चलो जल्द ही मिलते हैं!

lessons.cultural_notes: In Telugu-speaking cultures, greetings often reflect respect, with 'నమస్తే' used formally and hands pressed together in a gesture called 'Namaskaram.' Casual greetings like 'హాయ్' or 'ఏమిటి సంగతులు?' are common among friends. Smiling and nodding are typical during greetings.

lessons.cultural_notes: In Telugu introductions, sharing your name and hometown is common. Small talk often involves asking about family, food, or festivals, especially during social gatherings like weddings or community events.

lessons.title: Family

content.example: हमारा बड़ा भाई 25 साल का है.
मेरा छोटा भाई स्कूल में था.
मुझे अपनी बहन का डांस बहुत पसंद है.
मेरी बेटी पांच साल की है.
हमारे चाचा टेक्सास में रहते हैं।
हमारी चाची बहुत बढ़िया कुकीज़ बनाती हैं।

content.text: क्या आपकी बड़ी बहनें या बहनें हैं?
मेरे माता-पिता [आपके शहर] में रहते हैं।
मेरी दादी हमारे साथ रहती हैं।
मेरी बहन को डांस करना पसंद है.

lessons.cultural_notes: In Telugu culture, family is central, and extended families often live together. Respect for elders is shown by addressing them with terms like 'తాతయ్య' (grandfather) or 'అమ్మమ్మ' (grandmother). Family gatherings during festivals like Sankranti are common.

lessons.cultural_notes: In Telugu interactions, politeness is key, especially when asking for help or directions. Using 'దయచేసి' (please) and 'ధన్యవాదాలు' (thank you) is common in formal or unfamiliar settings. Smiling and maintaining eye contact are appreciated during conversations.
